subtitle: Lesson 2 · SOQL Fundamentals

code:
ORDER BY StageName ASC, Amount DESC

ORDER BY CloseDate DESC NULLS LAST
caption: ASC/DESC and multi-field sorts work exactly like T-SQL.

code:
-- T-SQL: TOP sits up front
SELECT TOP 10 Name, Amount FROM Opportunities

-- SOQL: LIMIT sits at the very end
SELECT Name, Amount FROM Opportunity
ORDER BY Amount DESC
LIMIT 10
caption: LIMIT is always the last clause in a SOQL query.
